hook.text: She mentioned Paris, her old job, and a fear of flying in one sentence. He only heard Paris. Three topics lost.

buildup.text: Every sentence contains multiple threads you could pull.

discovery.text: Listen for emotion words, unusual details, and topics they linger on. Those are invitations to go deeper.

twist.text: If you always pick the safe thread, conversations stay shallow.

climax.text: Practice: after someone speaks, mentally list three threads. Pick the one they seem most invested in and pull gently.

punchline.text: Every sentence hides three doors. Pick the right one.

quiz.question: What is conversational threading?
options: Staying on one topic until it is fully exhausted
Noticing multiple topics in a statement and choosing the richest to explore
Weaving your own stories into the other person's narrative
